clue.text: Overlook the markdown

definitions.meaning: to overlook something is to disregard it or leave it out of account
a markdown is a reduction in the marked price of goods

explanation.surface: Someone is told to ignore the reduced price ticket.
explanation.definitionFit: To disregard a possibility and a price reduction are both senses of the same word, verb and noun.

clue.text: Sound seed yield

indicators.note: sound tells us the word that follows is to be heard spoken, giving a word that is said the same

parts.note: taken as written, then said aloud

explanation.surface: A healthy seed gives a good crop.
explanation.definitionFit: To yield territory or a point is to give it up, a synonym.

clue.text: Scarcely daring to accept money

indicators.note: one word taking in another is shown by accepting, so the money letter goes inside the word for daring

parts.note: a hardy person is bold and daring
L stands for pound (libra), British money

explanation.surface: Someone is barely brave enough to take a payment.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarcely and its synonym both mean only just or almost not.

clue.text: Remonstrance for having duplicated invitation

indicators.note: duplicated says the word for the invitation appears twice in a row

parts.note: come is a one-word invitation to approach

explanation.surface: Someone protests at receiving the same invitation twice.
explanation.definitionFit: The doubled phrase is a mild rebuke or protest, said to calm or reprove someone, so it is a remonstrance.

clue.text: A ringer-up's quite possibly floored!

indicators.note: quite possibly signals that the letters of the opening words might be arranged into something else

parts.note: all ten letters, including the S of the contraction, are the fodder

explanation.surface: Someone who rang up has apparently been knocked down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quite possibly' rearranges A RINGERUPS. 'Floored' in the surface means knocked over; in the whole clue it means laid on a floor, as carpets are, so the clue is an &lit.
explanation.definitionFit: An oriental carpet made in Iran is laid across a floor, hence floored.

clue.text: Put down RAF officers in a letter

indicators.note: in puts the officers inside the spelt-out name of the letter

parts.note: DEE is the spelt-out name of the letter D
PO is a Pilot Officer in the Royal Air Force; plural POS

explanation.surface: An air force writes up its officers in a letter of reprimand.
explanation.definitionFit: To put down a ruler is to remove them from power, a synonym.

clue.text: Sacked a representative exposing miners to danger

parts.note: sacked means dismissed from a job, fired
an MP, Member of Parliament, is an elected representative

explanation.surface: A dismissed official put workers underground at risk.
explanation.definitionFit: This methane gas collecting in coal pits is explosive, a constant hazard for those working there.

clue.text: Calls-finds Father's at home

parts.note: Pops is a name for father, and the 's stands for is
in means at home

explanation.surface: Someone telephoning finds their dad is in.
explanation.definitionFit: To visit briefly and informally is to call, as in calling on a neighbour.

clue.text: Construction of doe pen must be started

indicators.note: construction of means building these letters into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Building an enclosure for a female deer has to begin.
explanation.definitionFit: Opened, as in opened proceedings, means began.

clue.text: Having a credit note, gives ground

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit; that the letters also run through the words a credit is a coincidence, since note still has to supply its E
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: Someone with a credit slip makes a concession.
explanation.definitionFit: This unit of land area measures ground, as in a few of them of farmland.

clue.text: One's pride's being damaged. Can result in low spirits

indicators.note: being damaged means the letters of the preceding words are knocked into a new shape

parts.note: taken as written, the S included
taken as written, the S included

explanation.surface: Wounded pride can leave a person feeling down.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of gloom and dejection is low spirits.

clue.text: Equip in flexible fashion

definitions.meaning: to equip is to provide or furnish with what is needed
an adverb from supple: in a pliant, bending manner

explanation.surface: An instruction to kit someone out in a bendy, adaptable way.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means provide; as an adverb from supple it means pliantly.

clue.text: Police raid may be made from time to time

definitions.note: an adverbial phrase defining an adjective: recurring at intervals

indicators.note: may be made from says the letters can be formed into something else

explanation.surface: Police raids happen every so often.
explanation.definitionFit: Recurring at regular intervals, as a magazine issued weekly or monthly is.

clue.text: Devotee of a single party after a while

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, single
a do is a party
later means after a while

explanation.surface: A loyal supporter of a one-party state turns up eventually.
explanation.definitionFit: A worshipper of images or an excessive admirer is a devotee.

clue.text: A painter getting the wind up?

definitions.meaning: J. M. W. ... was an English landscape painter
one who turns or winds a handle, cryptically one who winds up

explanation.surface: An artist is getting nervous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Getting the wind up' is British slang for becoming frightened; here it is read literally as one who turns, i.e. winds, something.
explanation.definitionFit: The landscape artist J. M. W. Turner, and one who rotates or winds something.

clue.text: No longer cared for, being so lengthy

parts.note: ex means former, no longer
tended means looked after, cared for

explanation.surface: Someone once looked after for a long time is now neglected.
explanation.definitionFit: Stretched out at length, prolonged, a synonym.

clue.text: Making such a suit a man needs expertise

parts.note: he refers to a man
arts means skills or expertise

explanation.surface: Tailoring a suit takes a man of skill.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the four suits in a pack of cards.

clue.text: They'll purchase a jumper on board

indicators.note: on, as in on board, puts the jumper inside the ship's letters

parts.note: SS, steamship, is the conventional ship one goes on board
a hopper is one who jumps

explanation.surface: Buyers wearing a sweater on a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jumper' suggests a sweater (British for a knitted pullover), but it is a hopper. 'On board' is the convention for putting something inside SS.
explanation.definitionFit: People who purchase goods in stores are those who buy.

clue.text: Bars giving the old king Continental articles

parts.note: GR is Georgius Rex, King George
il is the Italian for the
le is the French for the

explanation.surface: Foreign goods supplied to the former monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A grating of metal bars across a window or opening.

clue.text: Journalist writing about ale

parts.note: re means about, concerning
porter is a dark beer

explanation.surface: A newspaper writer files a piece about beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A news writer who covers stories is a journalist.

clue.text: He avoids backing the revolutionary way

indicators.note: backing says the pieces that follow are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: a red is a communist revolutionary
AVE is an abbreviation for avenue, a way

explanation.surface: A draft dodger dislikes supporting a revolutionary path.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who escapes or dodges something.

clue.text: The French turn on the water

parts.note: la is the French for the
a go is a turn
taken as written

explanation.surface: French people switch on the tap.
explanation.definitionFit: A stretch of shallow salt water cut off by a reef or sandbank.

clue.text: Meanly treated non-professionals

indicators.note: treated means the letters are processed into a new order

explanation.surface: Amateurs are handled stingily.
explanation.definitionFit: Laypeople, those without professional training, are amateurs.

clue.text: Deal fairly with a colleague in a sensible way

parts.note: to ration is to share out in fair portions
an ally is an associate or colleague

explanation.surface: Treat a workmate justly and with good sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Reasonably, by reason, sensibly.

clue.text: Many take off, that's the point

parts.note: C, the Roman numeral 100, stands for many
to ape is to mimic, take off

explanation.surface: A lot of planes depart, and that is the purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: A headland, a point of land projecting into the sea.

clue.text: Allude to it in church

indicators.note: in puts it inside the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Mention it during a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: To quote or mention as an example is to refer to it.

clue.text: A young lady scoffed, causing dispute

parts.note: a deb, debutante, is a young lady entering society
scoffed means ate greedily

explanation.surface: A girl's mockery provokes an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal argument or discussion is a dispute.

clue.text: Builders in secret or otherwise

indicators.note: otherwise means the letters are arranged in another way

explanation.surface: Construction workers sworn to secrecy or not.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who put up structures, constructors.
